Load Areas data file

load("./euc_sideroxylum_processed_data/euc_sideroxylum_areas_data_cleaned.RData")
euc_sideroxylum_areas_data_for_water_loss <-
  
    euc_sideroxylum_areas_data_cleaned %>%
  
        group_by(spcode, tree_id, set_temperature, string_number, vpd_control) %>% 
        
        # Convert cm2 to m2
        mutate(areas_m2 = areas_cm2/10000,
               double_sided_areas_m2 = double_sided_areas_cm2/10000,
               leaf_areas_m2 = if_else(organ == "leaves", areas_m2, 0)
               ) %>% 

        summarise(areas_m2 = sum(areas_m2),
                  
                  # Sum leaf areas by 0 to get just the leaf areas column
                  leaf_areas_m2 = sum(leaf_areas_m2),
                  
                  double_sided_areas_m2 = sum(double_sided_areas_m2))  %>% 
        
        mutate(set_temperature = as.integer(set_temperature), 
               .keep =  "unused") %>% 
        
        # Reorganize columns
        select(spcode, string_number, tree_id, set_temperature, everything()) %>% 
        arrange(vpd_control)
glimpse(euc_sideroxylum_areas_data_for_water_loss)

3. Calculate species water loss

Filter data in the 50% to 90% range RWC

euc_sideroxylum_rwc_data_filtered_data <-
    euc_sideroxylum_rwc_data %>%
        filter(relative_water_content_perc <= 0.90 & relative_water_content_perc >= 0.50)

Plot filtered data

Filter data with poor R2

euc_sideroxylum_data_for_water_loss <- 

    euc_sideroxylum_rwc_data_filtered_data  %>% 

    # Remove data with poor R2
    filter(!(vpd_control == "yes" & string_number == "string_7" & set_temperature == 50)) %>% 
    filter(!(vpd_control == "yes" & string_number == "string_8" & set_temperature == 50)) %>% 
    
    filter(!(vpd_control == "yes" & string_number == "string_7" & set_temperature == 55)) %>% 
    filter(!(vpd_control == "yes" & string_number == "string_8" & set_temperature == 55)) 
save(euc_sideroxylum_data_for_water_loss, 
     file = "./euc_sideroxylum_processed_data/euc_sideroxylum_rwc_filtered_data.RData")

Calculate the water loss rate of change

euc_sideroxylum_slopes <-
    calculate_rate_of_change(euc_sideroxylum_data_for_water_loss)
[1] "Rate of change units: grams * s-1"
[1] "Remember time units must be seconds and weights must be in grams"
# Make sure the maximum row length of the data frame slopes is:
# 8 (individuals)  * 6 (temperatures) + 8 (individuals)  * 7 (temperatures) = 48 + 56 = 104
nrow(euc_sideroxylum_slopes)
[1] 98

Calculate transpiration rates

euc_sideroxylum_transpiration_rates <- 
  calculate_transpiration_rates(droughtbox_data = euc_sideroxylum_data_for_water_loss,
                                leaf_and_branch_area_data = euc_sideroxylum_areas_data_for_water_loss)
[1] "Rate of change units: grams * s-1"
[1] "Remember time units must be seconds and weights must be in grams"

Plot transpiration data

# Add spcode to data before saving 

euc_sideroxylum_water_loss_data <- 
  
  euc_sideroxylum_transpiration_rates %>% 
    
  mutate(spcode = "euc_sideroxylum") %>% 
  select(-c(median_vpd, median_vpd, median_rh, median_temp)) %>% 
  select(spcode, everything())

4. Export data

save(euc_sideroxylum_water_loss_data, 
     file = "./euc_sideroxylum_processed_data/euc_sideroxylum_water_loss_data.RData")
